name: sheet
title: Sheet
summary: Side-anchored or top/bottom-anchored panel built on Radix Dialog. Sliding entry from the chosen side. Includes Sheet, SheetTrigger, SheetClose, SheetContent, SheetHeader, SheetFooter, SheetTitle, SheetDescription.
description: Side panel overlay built on Radix Dialog. Sides: left | right (default) | top | bottom.
skillDescription: Use when an action requires a focused side surface — settings, filters, contextual help, AI conversation. Composed from Radix Dialog so keyboard / scrim / focus-trap behavior is correct. Side defaults to right; switch to bottom for mobile.
useWhen: AI conversation embedded in a dashboard.
anatomy: SheetContent — the sliding panel, 75% viewport width default, max-w-sm
api: `side` — left | right (default) | top | bottom on SheetContent.
All Radix Dialog props pass through.
Modal / non-modal via Radix `modal` prop on the Root.
never: NEVER nest a Sheet inside another Sheet without an a11y reason.
NEVER replace the close X without preserving the SheetClose role and aria-label.
NEVER apply backdrop-filter to the overlay — it's a scrim, not a glass surface.
a11yRules: Radix manages role=dialog, aria-modal, focus trap, escape-to-close, click-outside-to-close.
Always provide a SheetTitle (visible or sr-only); Radix warns if missing.
Use SheetDescription for the assistive technology description.
do: Provide a SheetTitle for screen readers.
dont: Don't replace the scrim with a backdrop-filter blur.
